_doc: Gait defaults by swimming style (data only). A record picks its style with body.motion.gait; until records carry it, 'byPlan' below fills it in. Any key here can be overridden by body.motion.gaitOverrides. recoil (v2): share of the free-body Lighthill recoil left after the water resists sideways motion; 0.5 fitted to the snapper posterior wavelength and snout sway, see motion/swim/v2. fOffsetU (v3): beat law offset c in f = f_rec (c+U)/(c+U_rec); 1 L/s from Bainbridge 1958, matches Tytell 2004 eel (1.3 + 1.3 U). idleHz (v4): body-wave beat kept when the wanted speed is zero (eel station holding; no forward thrust below the beat law offset). perch-hop v5: hopBL (default length, est. 1-5 L), hopBurst s, hopTauU (burst speed-up), glide tau, glideEnd (share of burst speed where the brake starts), brakeTau. hopCal 1.17: measured ratio of commanded to travelled hop length with burst 0.2 s (0.85-0.86 for 1-6 L). skinStrain (v6): the turn bend is capped at skinStrain / widest half-width of the bending body (probe K3 limit 0.10 with margin). tempo (v7): speed wander cv (log sd) and yawSD deg/s with correlation time T s, always on unless cmd.tempo = 0; with cmd.auto the engine also pauses (pauseRate per s, pause [min,max] s; eel/moray 1.5-5 s, cowfish 2-6 s from probe K12 ranges) and bursts (burstRate, burst s, burstK x U). Estimates until blueprint swim blocks carry them; measured kinematic checks run with tempo 0. surge (v7): forward speed oscillates at twice the beat (one push per stroke), share of U: estimates 0.06 carangiform-like, 0.04 eel (Tytell 2004 reports small eel surge); applied to travel only. windDeg (v8): turn wind-up, head swung this far the other way at 90 ms before a turn from straight (tuskfish hero_motion feel.anticipation 5 deg, raised for read at game distance); 0 for the boxfish (rigid carapace turns by fins); cmd.wind = 0 switches it off. windYaw (v8): counter-yaw rate deg/s during the wind-up for bodies that cannot bend (boxfish). v12 breathing and soft body: throatDropD (share of the head depth at the throat, default 0.04; v13, was throatDrop 0.01 L) and opercleFlare (deg, default 6) at full record.breathing.amp, halved by ram ventilation above 1-2.5 L/s; softDrive (default 0.2): share of the station's sideways acceleration that reaches a soft zone's spring (the tissue mostly moves with the body; 0.2 keeps a fatty belly under its peak at cruise). finGait (v14, boxfish): median-fin gait shares by speed (Hove 2001: anal from 0 to full by 1 L/s, dorsal 0.8-1.5, caudal from Ulab), sway deg at full share (capped at 0.9 x the rig's fins.<fin>.sway room), lag = wave cycles along the fin, rockDeg = body yaw against the fins (snout excursion target 0.7-3.8 % TL), hoverHz and hoverShare = slow anal sculling at rest. finLife (v15, Gary 14 Nov 2026 02:05Z 'nothing should stay perfectly still'; the tuskfish's hero_motion FEEL_FINS, tail idle and alive layers, Fish lab 19 Oct): deg = median-fin ripple lean at hover (deg, capped at 0.9 x the rig's fins.<fin>.sway room), raiseDeg the rays' lift and fall with it, hz the fins' own frequency (each fish and fin x0.85-1.15), lam the ripple's wavelength along the fin (L, x0.85-1.15), periodCV / sizeCV the OU wander of frequency and size (tauF, tauS s), tailDeg / tailHz / tailLag the caudal idle scull about the fin base (tip lag in cycles), spreadDeg the lobes opening and closing (at 0.37 x tailHz; 1.5 deg keeps the fork membrane under 8 % edge stretch on the r22 snapper, 4 deg stretched it 17.8 %), pecPeriodCV / pecSizeCV each pectoral's own clock and size wander, pelvicDeg / tauP the pelvics' OU lean; all x (0.3 + 0.7 still), still = 1 - smoothstep(stillU), and x (1 - smoothstep(burstU)). A style or model may carry its own finLife. phrase (v16, Style FE2 14 Nov 2026; body-and-tail swimmers only, a style without it keeps the pectoral-only band; Fulton 2007: Lutjanus ~93 % body-and-tail fin use in the field; numbers ESTIMATES from Style's starting bars until a record carries them in body.motion.gaitOverrides.phrase): U = asked speed (L/s) over which the phrases fade in from rest; beats = the beat counts a phrase may draw; glide = [min, max] s; fK = beat rate in a phrase x the beat law, fVar its spread per phrase; ampK = beat size x the gait's amplitude at that speed, ampVar its spread per phrase; rise / fall = beats over which a phrase swells and dies; speedK = share of the asked speed gained through the beats, speedDn the most lost in a glide; differ = least difference of one phrase period from the last; tauA s = easing when the asked speed enters or leaves the slow band; pecTuck = share of the pectoral spread and stroke drawn in during the beats.

skillLaw._doc: factor = 1 + number x d, d = style skill - fish skill (+ = poorer swimmer)
